about: The load test's pass marks (docs/plans/S8/S8-7.md), written before any run. web/scripts/load-test.ts judges the measured ones and the owner's readings from the test project's logs and charts (refused database connections, database processor, database connections against max_connections), and exits non-zero when one fails or a reading is not given. The Cloud Run instance mark waits for the owner: the kit prints the peak against the limit without judging it.
